pearls.purpose: Public-relations / publication-ready surface — push curated content from peer Pearls (Doc, Sheets, Diagram) to a static site that's served to the open internet. The Pearl assembles + signs the static bundle; the Foundation's static-publish sidecar does the actual upload to the public CDN.

sidecars.label: Grain Crypto Journal
sidecars.purpose: Pre-publish drafts + per-publish audit trail encrypted.

sidecars.label: Identity Gate
sidecars.purpose: Each publish event is OTP-signed; the signed bundle hash is pinned.

requests.name: doc-read
requests.purpose: Pull doc content for the publish bundle.

requests.name: range-read
requests.purpose: Pull spreadsheet ranges as data tables.

adminOnly.name: Configure publish target
adminOnly.purpose: Owner-only: which static-publish endpoint, which signing wallet.

adminOnly.name: Push publish
adminOnly.purpose: OTP-gated; the signed bundle hash is recorded on-chain via release-entry pattern.

blockchains.purpose: Each publish creates a signed audit record; appHash + content-bundle hash are anchored.

staticPublishing.purpose: Push the assembled, signed publish bundle to the operator-configured public CDN target. The static-publish sidecar handles the upload; this Pearl only assembles + signs.

httpOut.purpose: All egress goes through the static-publish sidecar; no direct HTTP out.

interfaces.name: grain.MainView
interfaces.purpose: Standard Sandstorm grain interface — UiView for users opening the app, Restore for resuming a saved capability, Drop for releasing one.

incomingApi.purpose: Standard UiView; admin Powerbox claims for source caps.
